newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shares fall to fiscal year low.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shares fall to fiscal year low.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd extended losses on Monday afternoon, briefly touching a new low for this financial year.

The shares were still weighed down by news that some investment management firms would suspend business dealings with Nomura following its disclosure that two of its directors were involved in suspected illegal deals.

At 0435 GMT the shares were down 60 yen at 1,470 on volume of 6.584 million shares, the second-heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The price had briefly fallen to the year's low of 1,460 earlier in the afternoon.
The previous low of 1,470 yen was marked on January 10, 1997.
